checkpoint.basis: User recovery console in message 80, not independently queried in message 81

recommended_environment.type: Disposable isolated Windows x64 VM or equivalent dedicated disposable guest
recommended_environment.claim: Lab isolation proposal, not automatically applied or attested by JSON

proposed_service.name: SkynetVSGuard
proposed_service.existing_service_action: ABORT; never adopt, reconfigure, stop, start or delete existing entry
proposed_service.binary_path: Quoted exact guest-local per-run copy of pinned Guard.exe; no arguments
proposed_service.image_directory: New guest-local lab directory, outside production releases/store; actual path and inherited ACL verified before authorization
proposed_service.profile_caveat: Name/account/type preserved; effective SID/token/privilege settings are recorded, not a production-profile acceptance; no auto-fix or widening permissions. SCM implicit object/security creation is a real future write.

future_attempt_budget.failure_actions: No restart/reboot/run-command; verify absence before start, never configure to mask a failure

proposed_observations.prestart: Freshly created service STOPPED with initial exit fields recorded, exact config and absence of recovery/triggers; durable mutation intent before each operation
proposed_observations.start: Store BOOL and immediate error only on failure; call once. Nonzero alone does not accept the case. Zero is REVIEW/ERROR, never silently accepted as expected startup failure.
proposed_observations.poll: QueryServiceStatusEx raw structure, return code, returned byte count and timestamps; bounded polling, not a complete trace
proposed_observations.observed_running_or_other_state: FAIL/review and halt; no further starts

design.containment_difference: SCM owns process creation; R05 job-at-create, pipes and DETACHED_PROCESS do not apply to Guard. No fake claim of inherited controller job. Guest containment is separate.

future_cleanup.scope: Only the service object actually created by this run, on its retained creation handle with config recheck
future_cleanup.service_absence_gate: Close every owned service handle, then bounded OpenService read must yield ERROR_SERVICE_DOES_NOT_EXIST (1060); MARKED_FOR_DELETE/ACCESS_DENIED is not success
future_cleanup.unknown_or_hung_process: No taskkill/name scan or trusting stopped/pending PID; preserve evidence and use independently available guest shutdown/reset
future_cleanup.process_zero_claim: Not derived from SERVICE_STOPPED or DeleteService

controller_requirements.shape: Separate explicit native API client, not new service or injected shim; no reflection or ServiceNative replacement
controller_requirements.rights: Minimal manager CONNECT|CREATE_SERVICE and service QUERY_CONFIG|QUERY_STATUS|START|DELETE|READ_CONTROL as justified; no ALL_ACCESS or token adjustment
controller_requirements.input_mode: Self-contained signed-off capsule; no live project imports or user-switchable image/service/account
controller_requirements.timeouts: Observer/deletion deadlines must be fixed and tested before runtime. Blocking SCM RPC is not claimed forcibly cancellable; out-of-guest watchdog required.
controller_requirements.journal: Exclusive one-shot marker in guest plus host-side authorization consumption; append intents/results with raw codes; ambiguous Create/Start never replayed
controller_requirements.output: Evidence capture only; no boolean service response or raw JSON can mint P00; historical artifacts unmodified

requirements: ABI declarations from exact SDK with compile-only checks
Controller control-flow tests using fakes explicitly not SCM tests
Atomic create-not-adopt guard and one-shot budgets
Terminal status evaluator independent of localized console and process exit
Crash/partial state handling, DeleteService pending semantics, no unknown-PID killing
No native runtime until named guest, paths, ACL observations, controller build identities and separate execution consent exist
